captions.detailed: A 3D-printable S-hook featuring a hexagonal cross-section profile instead of a standard circular one, giving it a faceted, modern look. The hook consists of a top arc and a bottom arc connected by a short straight section. The ends of the hook are finished with slightly tapered, flat hexagonal end caps to prevent sharp edges.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric S-hook in OpenSCAD with a hexagonal cross-section. The design should allow the user to customize the profile radius, top and bottom hook radii, top and bottom closure angles, and the length of the connecting straight section.
captions.factory: The design uses a 2D circle with $fn=6$ to establish a hexagonal profile. The top and bottom hooks are generated using rotate_extrude with their respective closure angles, translating the hex profile by the hook radii. A straight connector is made by linear_extrude of the same profile. Tapered end caps are modeled using cylinders with $fn=6$ and placed at the open ends of the hooks using rotation and translation.
